_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Medicine extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes + active diagnosis ids (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53). In Medicine the condition-codes (outbreak_detected, bank... etc.) and the diagnosis ids NEVER textually equal an activation.diagnosticTriggers (which are FREE-TEXT clinical phrases like 'ED overcrowding'); this table bridges them so the adapter's alias-expansion (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L55-69) can protect co-circuit activations from extinction.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(medicine-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L246-303)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics validateDiagnoses L316-322)--> diagnosis id --(medicine.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations)--> their FREE-TEXT diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data). The condition-codes section adds the pulse-engine family hop, including shared-family cross-folds.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded onto a condition-code when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate, which is requiredFamilies with OR-semantics). Because four families are shared across diagnoses (clinical_event -> 4 diagnoses; system_event -> 3; pharmaceutical_event -> 3; access_event -> 2), a single token folds onto every diagnosis whose requiredFamilies it satisfies. Every link here satisfies that gate, so there are NO not-folded secondary cases (contrast Finance).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from medicine.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinanceAndEnergy: (1) LIKE ENERGY, UNLIKE FINANCE: Medicine activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT clinical phrases ('ED overcrowding','Imaging backlog'), NOT diagnosis ids. So diagnosis ids do NOT self-match activeTriggers and this alias table is STRICTLY REQUIRED (not merely protective of co-nodes as in Finance). (2) Medicine inlines classification (like Finance) and its condition-codes ARE the contract indicator tokens. (3) NO DEAD-END FAMILY: every family Medicine emits appears in some diagnosis requiredFamilies (contrast Finance's macro_event dead-end). (4) NO contract-only-unclassified tokens (contrast Energy REFINERY_ATTACK/SANCTIONS): every indicator token is handled by the inline classify. (5) _stress_* conditions are explicitly skipped (pulse-engine L243) and emit no family. (6) Orphan count: Medicine 1 (VTA), same as Energy; Finance had 3. (7) CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD alone has catchAllBlocked:false, but no _stress_ condition-code feeds it a family, so its catch-all path is external-stress marking, not a grounded condition-code (same structure as Finance SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION).

assets/js/energy-telemetry-adapter.js (REFERENCE pattern for activeTriggers build + alias expansion L55-69 + node-active-from-circuit L79-101; no medicine-telemetry-adapter.js exists yet)
assets/js/energy-extinction.js (REFERENCE match semantics L20-42; empty-diagnosticTriggers activations skipped L30; no medicine-extinction.js exists yet)

conditionCodes.reason: medicine-pulse-engine.js explicitly SKIPS any condition whose name starts with _stress_ (L242-243: 'must NOT map to any evidence family'). These are dynamically-generated stress tokens; they emit no family and are named in no contract, so there is no defensible condition->diagnosis link. The one catch-all-eligible diagnosis (CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD, catchAllBlocked:false) is reached by a diagnosis being externally marked active without required evidence (validateDiagnoses L324-326), NOT by any _stress_ condition-code, so no alias can be grounded here.

activationsWithTriggersButNoTriggerSourc.reason: Activation has non-empty diagnosticTriggers but its brainNodeId appears in NO issue._authored circuit (and no condition-code chain reaches it — it is absent from every diagnosis expansion above). Under current wiring nothing marks it active, so extinction would ALWAYS list it for retirement. No grounded alias exists; NOT fabricated. Needs authoring into an issue circuit before extinction should touch it.
